## Brand Strategy
- Subtitle "Advanced Edition" -- implies tiered guideline system (basic vs advanced).
- Emphasis on unified global identity: "We are now a global brand."
- Contact channel: brandidentity@spotify.com -- centralized brand governance.
- Four-pillar system: Colour, Typography, Burst, Photography. Every communication uses at least 2 of 4 elements, scaling complexity (2-element = simplest, 4-element = most expressive).

## Logo
- Logo = Icon + Wordmark combination.
- Icon symbolizes streaming, sound waves, movement, sharing, community.
- Spacing rule: gap between Icon and Wordmark equals the counter space in the lowercase "o" of the Wordmark.
- Strict usage rules -- logo must be used exactly as specified.

## Typography
- Listed as one of the four core brand pillars.
- Specific typeface details not captured in sampled pages (likely covered deeper in doc).

## Color
- Color is the foundational pillar -- appears as the base element in every combination tier.
- Specific palette not captured in sampled pages.

## Graphics
- "Burst" is a proprietary graphic element and one of the four pillars.
- Used as a layering/combination element alongside color, type, and photography.

## Photography
- Photography is the fourth pillar.
- Used in combination with other elements for expressive communications.

## Applications
- Tiered communication system: 2-element (simple) through 4-element (complex) compositions.
- Specific application examples not captured in sampled pages.

## Tone of Voice
- Friendly, informal Scandinavian tone ("Hej hej" as greeting).
- Direct, confident, pride in brand identity.
- Community-oriented language.
